content: Deng, Lu & Chen (2016) 'Continuous Monitoring of A/B Tests without Pain: Optional Stopping in Bayesian Testing', IEEE DSAA 2016, Montreal QC, Oct 17-19 2016, pp.243-252 (confirmed via dblp/arXiv/ResearchGate). Theorem 1 proves validity of Bayesian testing under a proper stopping rule via change-of-measure (likelihood-ratio argument), not Ville's inequality. Matches 09-CONTEXT.md D-10/D-12 findings verified against the arXiv LaTeX source directly.
